work.description: Brief LIV (address LF9752–9753) lets a professed Knight of St John make a will, reserving a fifth to the order; LF9808 → LF9820 across own provenance LF9811, margin mark LF9814 and page-67 running title LF9817; complete 28 August 1835 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP.
